Sheer ivory linen drapes hang from a brass rod over a multi-pane white casement window, admitting soft diffused daylight. A large fiddle-leaf fig in a weathered terracotta pot stands in the right corner. The floor is wide-plank warm oak. A worn Persian-style area rug in cream and dusty taupe covers the floor at the foot of the bed. A warm, soft amber glow from the nightstand surface illuminates the area around the window, casting a gentle bloom on the adjacent wall and drapes. Camera is at standing eye-level, centered symmetrical composition. The mood is lived-in and serene, a softly styled cottage bedroom.
